title: Seeded historical K-best learned-opponent league pilot
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: Starting from the same three frozen anchors as the matched fresh-only control, then retaining two loss-selected current-policy historical snapshots in a five-member adaptive league will create a more informative learned-policy curriculum and improve robust multi-anchor performance without source-policy drift.
material_change: Add distinct initial-opponent seeding that permits historical snapshot insertion, make adaptive league state identity-safe across dynamic K-best membership changes, and make assignment provenance replay support varying pool membership. After tests and a bounded smoke, run a 262,144-hand all-policy-head treatment matched to adaptive-league-all-heads-pilot-20260830 except for seeded dynamic loss-K-best snapshots every eight updates.
baseline: adaptive-league-all-heads-pilot-20260830: fixed three-opponent adaptive fresh-only PPO, same seed 20260852, worker deal stream 2026085200, all-policy-head scope, and 263,602 actual hands; its frozen iter16/32/48/64 curve is the untouched control.
source: AlphaHoldem AAAI 2022 K-Best Self-Play; alpha-replay-buffer-pilot-20260830 rejected replay scale and explicitly selected a true historical learned-opponent league as next step.

notes: Preregistered treatment: no PPO replay; resume Standard10 only as model initialization with optimizer and hand counter reset; seed pool from Standard10, slumbot_free, corrected_cfr96; k=5 loss-kbest; snapshot every 8 updates; adaptive per-group league; all-policy-head-only training. Promotion requires no health regression and directionally consistent paired improvement versus the untouched control across checkpoints/anchors, not a single noisy mean.

Implementation preflight passed: train_v5.py py_compile and 12/12 dynamic-pool plus replay/resume tests. Smoke intentionally snapshots every update to exercise pool growth, pruning, identity-safe adaptive state, and varying-membership provenance before production cadence is relaxed to every eight updates.

Smoke passed. Three iterations produced 844 actual hands; provenance chain is valid with pool sizes 3->4->5 and exact snapshot memberships; final checkpoint retains five matching adaptive EMA/weight/observation entries summing to probability 1, ten optimizer states, and six candidate-history rows. At the third insertion candidate id5 was correctly rejected and local order changed, exercising identity-safe remapping.

Starting preregistered 262,144-hand production treatment. Untouched matched control is adaptive-league-all-heads-pilot-20260830; treatment uses the same three initial anchors, seed 20260852, worker seed/deal stream 2026085200, all-policy-head scope, trust-region settings, and 4,096 hands/update. Only historical snapshot admission/K-best membership is materially changed.

Production terminal audit PASS: 64 contiguous metric rows, 64 cryptographically verified assignment rows with exact dynamic RNG replay, membership changes only after iterations 8/16/32, final pool ids [0,1,2,6,3], two learned survivors, ten optimizer states all at step 1868, 263,581 actual hands, and complete archive/artifact SHA256 evidence.
Starting preregistered iter16 fresh-only multi-anchor evaluation against the exact untouched adaptive-league-all-heads control curve; 1,024 mirrored pairs per anchor, seed 20260853.
Completed iter16 matched fresh-only evaluation and paired treatment-minus-control calculation; 6,144 new internal evaluation hands.
Starting iter32 matched multi-anchor evaluation; this checkpoint has trained for 16 updates against a pool containing learned id3 and reaches the second learned admission boundary.
Completed iter32 matched fresh-only evaluation and paired delta; cumulative internal evaluation hands now 12,288.
Starting iter48 matched evaluation after stable full-pool K-best training and the id6-for-id4 membership replacement.
Completed iter48 matched fresh-only evaluation and paired delta; cumulative internal evaluation hands now 18,432.
Starting final iter64 matched evaluation. Promotion remains contingent on consistent lower-variance Standard10/slumbot_free direction plus no contradictory anchor evidence.
Completed all four preregistered matched fresh-only checkpoints: 4 x 3 anchors x 2,048 hands = 24,576 new internal evaluation hands; paired deltas reuse these outcomes and are not double-counted.

Curve conclusion: 5/12 all-anchor paired rows positive, unweighted mean -0.283 and median -0.270 bb/100. Standard10 plus slumbot_free rows were 4/8 positive with mean -0.274. Iter64 alone had Standard10 +0.439 CI95 [+0.023,+0.856], slumbot_free +0.161 CI crossing zero, and CFR96 -0.904 CI crossing zero. This is not robust enough to scale training, but the final checkpoint merits exactly one independently seeded matched replication.

result.summary: Implemented and audited identity-safe seeded dynamic K-best training, completed 263,581 actual environment hands, and evaluated four frozen checkpoints on 24,576 fresh internal hands against an untouched matched control.
result.conclusion: The infrastructure and training run succeeded: dynamic membership, adaptive weights, assignment RNG provenance, optimizer state, and four checkpoint hashes all passed audit; two learned snapshots survived K-best selection and the policy stayed inside the source trust region. The strength hypothesis did not pass the preregistered robust curve test: only 5/12 paired checkpoint-anchor rows were positive, the mean and median deltas were negative, and no checkpoint improved all anchors. Iter64 produced a narrow positive Standard10 delta and a positive but inconclusive slumbot_free point estimate, while CFR96 remained negative and inconclusive.
result.next_step: Do not scale this proxy K-best curriculum. Run exactly one independent-deal-seed matched replication of frozen iter64 versus the same frozen fresh-only iter64 control; if lower-variance anchors do not replicate positive direction, retire this route. If they do, deepen only the final checkpoint before any Slumbot spend.
